title: SQLite: The Database at the Edge of the Network with Dr. Richard Hipp
summary: SQLite creator Richard Hipp gives a history of SQLite and explains where it shines as a database at the edge of the network with no DBA. He covers long-term support, testing and how it is used in products.
why: HN recommends it as an enthusiastic, funny talk straight from the creator, and cites it for facts like the name's pronunciation and Airbus support.

quote.text: I highly recommend to watch it, if only to get a sense of the smart and funny energy that Dr Richard Hipp puts off!
